info.title: Istanbul University MIS Alumni Portal API
info.description: Comprehensive OpenAPI / Swagger specification for the Istanbul University Faculty of Economics — Management Information Systems (MIS) Alumni Portal & Tracking System. Documents the MVC architecture web endpoints, RESTful JSON API CRUD operations for Users, and Alumni directory endpoints.
